title: azukia angularis var. nipponensis
intro: Azukia angularis var. nipponensis, commonly known as Japanese mountain yam, is a variety of the Azukia angularis plant, native to East Asia and belonging to the Dioscoreaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antidiabetic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the management of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Japanese mountain yam are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve constipation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include dioscorin, diosgenin, and other saponins, which have been shown to possess various pharmacological properties.
